profile.title: Profile

profile.animationsIntro: The moving name borders and backgrounds from the shop, yours and other players'.
profile.backgroundAnimationIntro: How your animated website background looks. Each slider is an unlock in the shop (Unlocks tab).
profile.languageIntro: The language of the site, and of every game that has been translated into it.
profile.backgroundIntro: The picture behind the site. Games stay on a calm panel, so it never gets in the way of play.

profile.cardBackIntro: What the face-down cards look like to you in every card game.

profile.markerIntro: The colour of your markers in games such as Tints and Hints and Wavelength. A game gives it to you when you join, if nobody there has it already; you can still change it in the lobby.

profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
